items.title: Salt would like extra week in Hundred schedule
items.summary: Welsh Fire captain Phil Salt says ideally he would like The Hundred to be a week longer after his side played three matches in five days.
items.whyItMatters: Cricket gives XLB a stronger India-relevant sports lane and a reason for repeat sports check-ins.

items.title: Cubs sweep Dodgers behind Pete Crow-Armstrong's mounting NL MVP campaign vs. Shohei Ohtani
items.summary: Crow-Armstrong and Ohtani both homered twice Wednesday and are now tied in the NL MVP odds

items.title: Infantino remains Fifa president after executive meeting
items.summary: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president after he receives the backing of senior executives in a meeting in Morocco.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.
